summary: Added the Terraform service afaw-demo-app (public invoker, deployer run.developer, same limits as the dashboard) and ignore_changes on env for both services so a plan does not wipe the variables CI sets. Added package_demo_app, publish_demo_image and deploy_demo_app to .gitlab-ci.yml; the last fails unless the live service reports the commit and exports DEMO_APP_URL. The tests job also runs tests/notes. Documented in docs/demo-app.md, README and PENDING.md (orchestrator, context handoff, bug benchmarks planned).
